surface: Re-exports `@tanstack/db@0.6.17` unchanged and implements its live-query binding surface (`useLiveQuery`, `useLiveInfiniteQuery`, `useLiveSuspenseQuery`, `useLiveQueryEffect`, `usePacedMutations`) on Octane hooks.
divergences: Suspense integrates via octane's `use(thenable)` rather than throwing a promise (observable behavior matches).
ssr: Not yet exercised: no server-render tests are included for the live-query hooks.
notes: Behavioral conformance runs the shared `@tanstack/db` live-query conformance suite against the Octane adapter, plus coverage for suspense, effect hooks, paced mutations, and eager onStoreChange; type tests cover the `useLiveQuery` overload families.

The `@tanstack/db` expression evaluator and comparison utilities are vendored under `tests/db-fixtures/db-internal/` (pinned to 0.6.17) so the infinite-query tests can interpret the where/cursor IR db generates internally; these are test-only and not shipped.
